Title: Quiz accessible for undiscovered Wildlife Card
Reproduction: Use a new child with no collection entries; request GET /api/v1/species/sp_malayan_tiger/quiz?difficulty=easy.
Actual: Endpoint returned HTTP 200 quiz data for the empty collection.

Title: Quiz submit bypasses sequential difficulty
Reproduction: With a new child, POST correct answers for a Medium set before Easy is passed.
Expected: Medium must remain locked until Easy is passed 5/5.
Actual: Medium passed and Ability 2 recorded while easy_passed remained false.

Title: Discovered card shows only three Fun Facts
Reproduction: Open any discovered Wildlife Card and inspect its Fun Facts tab.
Expected: The card shows approved information and 10 Fun Facts.
Actual: All sampled discovered cards show the card fun fact plus two generic safety statements: 3 total.

Title: Quiz no answer message
Reproduction: Start Easy quiz; without choosing an option attempt Next.
Expected: Disable Next and keep the child on the current question until an answer is selected.
Actual: Retest: Next was disabled and the child remained on question 1. The amended AC no longer requires a message.
